platforms.name: Edge Radio 99.3FM Global Digital Music Submission
platforms.country: Australia / Hobart youth-focused community radio explicitly welcoming artists from Tasmania, Australia and around the world
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated. Paid on-air promotional campaigns are offered separately and are not required for editorial airplay consideration.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Edge Radio accepts digital submissions through an official protected first-party email route and asks for a short bio, upcoming-gig details, a streaming link and a high-quality downloadable file in 320 kbps MP3, AAC, WAV, FLAC or OGG. The actual mailbox is protected in passive rendering and was not decoded. A human must open the official page, confirm the displayed address, select and permission-check the stream and download links, approve the bio and ensure the submission is not falsely labelled as Tasmanian. The optional multi-copy CD route and any paid promotional campaign must remain separate.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from Edge Radio's official Submit Your Music page, homepage and current program guide. The station explicitly says it supports new and emerging artists in Tasmania, Australia and around the world. Its July 2026 site activity and weekly schedule include New Music on Edge Radio, Sub-sequence for electronic and experimental music, The Tiki Lounge Remix for digital beats and world music, and programs covering reggae and hip-hop. The digital submission address is presented through first-party email protection and was observed but not decoded or stored. No email, file, link or physical package was sent, and no SMTP, MX or mailbox probe was performed.

platforms.name: SYN Media Rolling Music Submission
platforms.country: Australia / Melbourne youth-run independent broadcaster with rolling music review
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, membership, login or payment requirement is stated for the official rolling music-submission mailbox.
platforms.manualReviewReason: SYN directs music submissions to music@syn.org.au and requires a downloadable 320 kbps MP3 or WAV link rather than direct file attachments, plus a press release or artist bio, track or EP/album title, release date and relevant website, social, gig or previous-release links. A human must choose the release and focus track, confirm that the download link is accessible without exposing private credentials, verify file quality and metadata, review the pitch and send the email manually. Rolling review does not guarantee a response.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from SYN Media's official contact page and 2026 review archive. The first-party page publishes music@syn.org.au specifically for music submissions and separately identifies music.content@syn.org.au for interview requests, preventing route conflation. SYN remained editorially active in 2026, including a 25 May live review and a 30 April review of the Glitch Melbourne electronic festival. The submission mailbox was checked for first-party publication, syntax, domain alignment and role relevance only. No email, attachment or download link was sent and no SMTP, MX, catch-all or deliverability probe was performed.

platforms.name: JOY 94.9 Global and Rainbow Artist Music Submission
platforms.country: Australia / Melbourne independent LGBTQIA+ community broadcaster celebrating Australian and global music
platforms.feeAmount: No editorial submission fee, membership or payment requirement is stated. JOY's donations, memberships and commercial services are separate from music consideration.
platforms.manualReviewReason: JOY invites artists who are Australian, independent or part of LGBTIQA+ communities and whose music fits its daytime or specialist programming to send a stream link through an official protected first-party music address. The mailbox was not decoded. A human must confirm the displayed address, verify that MarcsMusic qualifies through the independent-artist criterion, select an uplifting or specialist-fit track, approve the stream permissions and submit manually. Physical CD delivery and direct outreach to a specialist show are optional routes requiring separate human approval. The CAPTCHA and honeypot visible on the page belong to an unrelated newsletter form and must not be used as a submission path.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from JOY's official Submit Your Music page and current homepage. JOY says it celebrates Australian and global music and focuses on rainbow artists where possible, with daytime pop, R&B and uplifting remixes plus specialist alternative, world and other genre programming. Current activity was confirmed through Season Two beginning 6 July 2026 and podcasts dated 10-12 July 2026. The music address is protected in passive rendering and was not decoded or stored. No email, stream link, CD, show contact, newsletter form or CAPTCHA was used, and no SMTP, MX or mailbox probe was performed.
